#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Read-only interval decomposition of the captured RenderThread Declare bodies."""
import bisect
import collections
import hashlib
import json
import pathlib
import statistics

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent
EPSILON_MS = 0.0002
SOURCE_NAMES = [
    "json/etw/timeline-metadata.json",
    "json/etw/thread-28068.json",
    "json/baseline/summary.json",
]
source_bytes = {name: (ROOT / name).read_bytes() for name in SOURCE_NAMES}
meta, owner, baseline = (json.loads(source_bytes[name]) for name in SOURCE_NAMES)
names = meta["markers"]
on = next(window for window in meta["windows"] if window["name"] == "on")
begin, end = on["begin"], on["end"]


def stats(values):
    ordered = sorted(values)
    if not ordered:
        return {"n": 0}
    return {
        "n": len(ordered), "mean_ms": statistics.fmean(ordered),
        "p50_ms": statistics.median(ordered),
        "p95_ms": ordered[min(len(ordered) - 1, int(len(ordered) * .95))],
        "min_ms": ordered[0], "max_ms": ordered[-1],
        "sum_ms": sum(ordered),
    }


def contains(parent, child):
    return (parent[0] - EPSILON_MS <= child[0]
            and child[0] + child[1] <= parent[0] + parent[1] + EPSILON_MS)


def union_duration(scopes, clip=None):
    intervals = sorted((scope[0], scope[0] + scope[1]) for scope in scopes)
    total, previous_end = 0., float("-inf")
    for left, right in intervals:
        if clip:
            left = max(left, clip[0])
            right = min(right, clip[0] + clip[1])
        if right > max(left, previous_end):
            total += right - max(left, previous_end)
        previous_end = max(previous_end, right)
    return total


scopes = [scope for scope in owner["scopes"] if scope[1] > 0
          and not scope[4] & 3 and scope[0] >= begin
          and scope[0] + scope[1] <= end]
declares = sorted((scope for scope in scopes if names[scope[2]] == "RenderGraphDeclare"),
                  key=lambda scope: scope[0])
declare_starts = [scope[0] for scope in declares]
groups = [[] for _ in declares]
for scope in scopes:
    index = bisect.bisect_right(declare_starts, scope[0] + EPSILON_MS) - 1
    if index >= 0 and contains(declares[index], scope):
        groups[index].append(scope)

api_names = {
    "RenderGraphDeclareImportBuffer", "RenderGraphDeclareImportTexture",
    "RenderGraphDeclareCreateTexture", "RenderGraphDeclareCreateBuffer",
    "RenderGraphDeclareAdvanceVersion", "RenderGraphDeclareInitializePass",
    "RenderGraphDeclareAddPass", "RenderGraphDeclareAddRepeatedPass",
    "RenderGraphDeclareAddSplitPass",
}
detail_names = api_names | {
    name for name in names if name.startswith(("GpuVisibility.", "MaterialDeclare",
                                              "MaterialScene", "ShadowFinalCull."))
}
rows = collections.defaultdict(list)
pre_first = []
overall = []
errors = []

for declare_index, (declare, group) in enumerate(zip(declares, groups)):
    render_matches = [measurement for measurement in meta["measurements"]
                      if contains(measurement, declare)]
    if len(render_matches) != 1:
        errors.append(["render_measurement_match_count", declare_index, len(render_matches)])
        view = 0
    else:
        view = render_matches[0][3]
    nodes = sorted((scope for scope in group if names[scope[2]].startswith("RenderDeclare.")),
                   key=lambda scope: scope[0])
    starts = [node[0] for node in nodes]
    node_groups = [[] for _ in nodes]
    for scope in group:
        index = bisect.bisect_right(starts, scope[0] + EPSILON_MS) - 1
        if index >= 0 and contains(nodes[index], scope):
            node_groups[index].append(scope)
    if len(nodes) != 37:
        errors.append(["named_node_count", declare_index, len(nodes)])

    body_sum = 0.
    for node, children in zip(nodes, node_groups):
        node_name = names[node[2]]
        bodies = [scope for scope in children if names[scope[2]] == "RenderGraphDeclareNodeBody"]
        if len(bodies) != 1:
            errors.append(["node_body_count", declare_index, node_name, len(bodies)])
            continue
        body = bodies[0]
        body_sum += body[1]
        body_children = [scope for scope in children if contains(body, scope)]
        api = [scope for scope in body_children if names[scope[2]] in api_names]
        build = [scope for scope in body_children if names[scope[2]] == "GpuVisibility.SharedBuild"]
        by_marker = collections.defaultdict(list)
        for scope in body_children:
            name = names[scope[2]]
            if name in detail_names:
                by_marker[name].append(scope[1])
        accounted = union_duration(api + build, body)
        rows[node_name].append({
            "view": view, "wall": node[1], "body": body[1],
            "api_union": union_duration(api, body),
            "shared_build_union": union_duration(build, body),
            "api_or_shared_build_union": accounted,
            "remaining_body": max(0., body[1] - accounted),
            "detail_counts": {name: len(values) for name, values in by_marker.items()},
            "detail_inclusive_ms": {name: sum(values) for name, values in by_marker.items()},
        })
        if node_name == "RenderDeclare.METEOR.Scene.Cull.First":
            meshlets = [scope for scope in body_children if names[scope[2]] == "GpuVisibility.MeshletDeclare"]
            first = min(meshlets, key=lambda scope: scope[0])
            before = [body[0], first[0] - body[0]]
            before_api = [scope for scope in api if contains(before, scope)]
            before_import = [scope for scope in before_api if names[scope[2]] == "RenderGraphDeclareImportTexture"]
            pre_first.append({
                "view": view, "body_to_meshlet_begin": before[1],
                "before_api_union": union_duration(before_api, before),
                "before_other": max(0., before[1] - union_duration(before_api, before)),
                "before_import_texture_count": len(before_import),
                "before_import_texture_inclusive": sum(scope[1] for scope in before_import),
                "first_meshlet": first[1],
            })

    api = [scope for scope in group if names[scope[2]] in api_names]
    builds = [scope for scope in group if names[scope[2]] == "GpuVisibility.SharedBuild"]
    accounted = union_duration(api + builds, declare)
    if abs(accounted - union_duration(api, declare) - union_duration(builds, declare)) > EPSILON_MS:
        errors.append(["api_build_overlap", declare_index])
    bodies = [scope for scope in group if names[scope[2]] == "RenderGraphDeclareNodeBody"]
    if abs(body_sum - union_duration(bodies, declare)) > EPSILON_MS:
        errors.append(["body_overlap", declare_index])
    if any(not any(contains(body, child) for body in bodies) for child in api + builds):
        errors.append(["api_or_build_outside_body", declare_index])
    packet = [scope for scope in group if names[scope[2]] in {
        "RenderGraphDeclarePacketDispatch", "RenderGraphDeclarePacketJoin",
        "RenderGraphDeclarePacketMerge", "RenderGraphDeclarePacketBuild"}]
    overall.append({"view": view, "wall": declare[1], "body_sum": body_sum,
                    "api_union": union_duration(api, declare),
                    "shared_build_union": union_duration(builds, declare),
                    "remaining_body": max(0., body_sum - accounted),
                    "owner_packet_union": union_duration(packet, declare),
                    "outside_bodies": max(0., declare[1] - body_sum)})


def aggregate_rows(samples, fields):
    return {field: stats([sample[field] for sample in samples]) for field in fields}


node_output = []
node_fields = ["wall", "body", "api_union", "shared_build_union",
               "api_or_shared_build_union", "remaining_body"]
for name, samples in rows.items():
    markers = sorted({marker for sample in samples for marker in sample["detail_counts"]})
    details = {}
    for marker in markers:
        counts = [sample["detail_counts"].get(marker, 0) for sample in samples]
        times = [sample["detail_inclusive_ms"].get(marker, 0.) for sample in samples]
        details[marker] = {
            "calls": sum(counts), "calls_per_node_mean": statistics.fmean(counts),
            "calls_per_node_min": min(counts), "calls_per_node_max": max(counts),
            "inclusive_ms_per_node": stats(times),
        }
    node_output.append({"name": name, **aggregate_rows(samples, node_fields),
                        "by_view": {str(view): aggregate_rows([s for s in samples if s["view"] == view], node_fields)
                                    for view in (1, 2)}, "details": details})
node_output.sort(key=lambda row: row["wall"]["mean_ms"], reverse=True)

baseline_markers = collections.defaultdict(list)
for marker in baseline["markers"]:
    if not marker.get("gpu"):
        baseline_markers[marker["name"]].append(marker)
baseline_declare_calls = sum(marker["calls"] for marker in baseline_markers["RenderGraphDeclare"])
baseline_output = {}
for name, markers in baseline_markers.items():
    if name in detail_names or name.startswith(("RenderGraphDeclare", "RenderDeclare.")):
        count = sum(marker["calls"] for marker in markers)
        total = sum(marker["calls"] * marker["mean"] for marker in markers)
        baseline_output[name] = {"calls": count, "calls_per_declare": count / baseline_declare_calls,
                                 "inclusive_ms_per_declare": total / baseline_declare_calls,
                                 "mean_ms_per_call": total / count,
                                 "per_thread": [{key: marker[key] for key in ("thread", "calls", "mean", "p50", "p95")}
                                                for marker in markers]}

overall_fields = ["wall", "body_sum", "api_union", "shared_build_union", "remaining_body", "owner_packet_union", "outside_bodies"]
pre_fields = ["body_to_meshlet_begin", "before_api_union", "before_other", "before_import_texture_inclusive", "first_meshlet"]
result = {
    "schema": "creator.render_graph_declare_interval_decomposition.v1",
    "capture_code_commit": "4eeba98f2c9ad5907debfa4eaa10b2f004afb149",
    "source": {name: {"bytes": len(raw), "sha256": hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()}
               for name, raw in source_bytes.items()},
    "scope": {
        "thread": owner["tid"], "window_ms": [begin, end],
        "admission": "duration > 0, flags & 3 == 0, fully inside ETW ON window; nested children fully inside admitted parent",
        "boundary_tolerance_ms": EPSILON_MS,
        "percentiles": "median p50; sorted[min(n-1, floor(n*.95))] p95, no interpolation",
        "view_mapping": "Render measurement containment; view 1 Scene, view 2 Game; not execution order",
        "limitations": [
            "Only ETW owner scopes have raw full-window decomposition here; baseline full capture uses summary aggregates.",
            "API union removes nested API double counting. SharedBindings is already inside SharedBuild.",
            "remaining_body includes all unprofiled body work, checks, allocations, loops, lambda/resource bookkeeping and instrumentation overhead; it is not allocator cost.",
            "The captured 4eeba98 code predates PR188 HEAD2e08a19 changes; no post-change performance result is asserted.",
            "ETW/Debug instrumentation can change small scope durations; these are observed wall intervals, not predicted speedups.",
        ],
    },
    "validation_errors": errors,
    "etw_declare": aggregate_rows(overall, overall_fields),
    "etw_declare_by_view": {str(view): aggregate_rows([s for s in overall if s["view"] == view], overall_fields) for view in (1, 2)},
    "etw_nodes": node_output,
    "etw_scene_first_before_meshlet": {
        **aggregate_rows(pre_first, pre_fields),
        "import_texture_count_distribution": dict(collections.Counter(s["before_import_texture_count"] for s in pre_first)),
        "by_view": {str(view): aggregate_rows([s for s in pre_first if s["view"] == view], pre_fields) for view in (1, 2)},
    },
    "baseline_full_summary": baseline_output,
}
destination = ROOT / "declare-body-analysis.json"
destination.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2) + "\n")
print("output", destination)
print("validation_errors", errors[:10], "total", len(errors))
print("Declare", {key: round(value["mean_ms"], 6) for key, value in result["etw_declare"].items()})
for node in node_output[:17]:
    print(node["name"], {key: round(node[key]["mean_ms"], 6) for key in node_fields})
print("before_meshlet", {key: round(result["etw_scene_first_before_meshlet"][key]["mean_ms"], 6) for key in pre_fields}, result["etw_scene_first_before_meshlet"]["import_texture_count_distribution"])
